versions.changelog: display name now leads with the capability
Agent onboarding: signup URL, auto-created key, free-credit budget and the 402 top-up path. Attribution links refreshed.

- Initial release of the website-screenshot-api skill.
- Capture full-page PNG screenshots from any public URL, returned as a base64 data URI.
- Supports three capture tiers: normal, advanced (1 credit each), and ultra (5 credits) for difficult sites.
- Only charges credits for successful captures.
- Returns detailed metadata: url, image, image_format, mode, and image_bytes.
- Requires a free API key (SCAVIO_API_KEY) for usage.
